scripts.turbo:start: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "$llama = if ($env:LLAMA_SERVER_PATH) { $env:LLAMA_SERVER_PATH } else { 'C:\Users\james\Desktop\llama-server-cuda\llama-server.exe' }; $model = if ($env:TURBO_MODEL_PATH) { $env:TURBO_MODEL_PATH } else { Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.ollama\blobs\sha256-a79de882a921b9c3781a95a8ef555ea51e7c4dd685a8b2854e9bbe73ab081b43' }; $mmproj = if ($env:TURBO_MMPROJ_PATH) { $env:TURBO_MMPROJ_PATH } else { Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'Downloads\gemma4-mmproj\mmproj-BF16.gguf' }; $port = if ($env:TURBO_PORT) { $env:TURBO_PORT } else { '8090' }; if (-not (Test-Path $llama)) { throw 'llama-server.exe not found' }; if (-not (Test-Path $model)) { throw 'TurboQuant model blob not found' }; $args = @('-m', $model, '--port', $port, '-ngl', '99', '--flash-attn', 'on', '-ctk', 'q8_0', '-ctv', 'q8_0', '-c', '4096'); if (Test-Path $mmproj) { $args = @('-m', $model, '--mmproj', $mmproj, '--port', $port, '-ngl', '99', '--flash-attn', 'on', '-ctk', 'q8_0', '-ctv', 'q8_0', '-c', '4096') }; & $llama @args"
scripts.turbo:start:detached: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "$llama = if ($env:LLAMA_SERVER_PATH) { $env:LLAMA_SERVER_PATH } else { 'C:\Users\james\Desktop\llama-server-cuda\llama-server.exe' }; $model = if ($env:TURBO_MODEL_PATH) { $env:TURBO_MODEL_PATH } else { Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.ollama\blobs\sha256-a79de882a921b9c3781a95a8ef555ea51e7c4dd685a8b2854e9bbe73ab081b43' }; $mmproj = if ($env:TURBO_MMPROJ_PATH) { $env:TURBO_MMPROJ_PATH } else { Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'Downloads\gemma4-mmproj\mmproj-BF16.gguf' }; $port = if ($env:TURBO_PORT) { $env:TURBO_PORT } else { '8090' }; try { Invoke-RestMethod ('http://127.0.0.1:' + $port + '/health') -TimeoutSec 1 | Out-Null; Write-Host ('TurboQuant already healthy on http://127.0.0.1:' + $port) -ForegroundColor Yellow; exit 0 } catch {}; if (-not (Test-Path $llama)) { throw 'llama-server.exe not found' }; if (-not (Test-Path $model)) { throw 'TurboQuant model blob not found' }; $args = @('-m', $model, '--port', $port, '-ngl', '99', '--flash-attn', 'on', '-ctk', 'q8_0', '-ctv', 'q8_0', '-c', '4096', '--log-disable'); if (Test-Path $mmproj) { $args = @('-m', $model, '--mmproj', $mmproj, '--port', $port, '-ngl', '99', '--flash-attn', 'on', '-ctk', 'q8_0', '-ctv', 'q8_0', '-c', '4096', '--log-disable') }; $proc = Start-Process -FilePath $llama -ArgumentList $args -PassThru -WindowStyle Hidden; $ready = $false; for ($i = 0; $i -lt 30; $i++) { try { Invoke-RestMethod ('http://127.0.0.1:' + $port + '/health') -TimeoutSec 1 | Out-Null; $ready = $true; break } catch { [System.Threading.Thread]::Sleep(500) } }; if (-not $ready) { try { Stop-Process -Id $proc.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {}; throw ('TurboQuant failed to become healthy on :' + $port) }; Write-Host ('TurboQuant ready on http://127.0.0.1:' + $port + ' (PID ' + $proc.Id + ')') -ForegroundColor Green"
scripts.turbo:start:text:detached: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "$llama = if ($env:LLAMA_SERVER_PATH) { $env:LLAMA_SERVER_PATH } else { 'C:\Users\james\Desktop\llama-server-cuda\llama-server.exe' }; $model = if ($env:TURBO_MODEL_PATH) { $env:TURBO_MODEL_PATH } else { Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.ollama\blobs\sha256-a79de882a921b9c3781a95a8ef555ea51e7c4dd685a8b2854e9bbe73ab081b43' }; $port = if ($env:TURBO_PORT) { $env:TURBO_PORT } else { '8090' }; try { Invoke-RestMethod ('http://127.0.0.1:' + $port + '/health') -TimeoutSec 1 | Out-Null; Write-Host ('TurboQuant already healthy on http://127.0.0.1:' + $port) -ForegroundColor Yellow; exit 0 } catch {}; if (-not (Test-Path $llama)) { throw 'llama-server.exe not found' }; if (-not (Test-Path $model)) { throw 'TurboQuant model blob not found' }; $args = @('-m', $model, '--port', $port, '-ngl', '99', '--flash-attn', 'on', '-ctk', 'q8_0', '-ctv', 'q8_0', '-c', '4096', '--log-disable'); $proc = Start-Process -FilePath $llama -ArgumentList $args -PassThru -WindowStyle Hidden; $ready = $false; for ($i = 0; $i -lt 30; $i++) { try { Invoke-RestMethod ('http://127.0.0.1:' + $port + '/health') -TimeoutSec 1 | Out-Null; $ready = $true; break } catch { [System.Threading.Thread]::Sleep(500) } }; if (-not $ready) { try { Stop-Process -Id $proc.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {}; throw ('TurboQuant failed to become healthy on :' + $port) }; Write-Host ('TurboQuant text-only ready on http://127.0.0.1:' + $port + ' (PID ' + $proc.Id + ')') -ForegroundColor Green"

'✅ canvas_states exists' : '❌ canvas_states MISSING'); c.end(); }).catch(e => { console.error('❌', e.message); c.end(); })"
